# Geck

> Geck is the fullstack platform for agentic commerce—helping AI agents find, recommend, and transact with your brand.

## Site
- Home: https://geck.ai/
- About: https://geck.ai/about
- FAQ: https://geck.ai/faq
- Contact: https://geck.ai/contact
- Privacy: https://geck.ai/privacy
- Typography & Brand Kit: https://geck.ai/typography

## Product summary
Geck helps brands get discovered in ChatGPT, Gemini, and AI search; structure content so AI agents can understand and cite it; and improve visibility across agentic commerce workflows.

## Key facts
- Category: Agentic commerce platform (AI visibility + agent optimization)
- Positioning: The fullstack platform for agentic commerce
- Primary users: marketing teams, growth leads, brand operators
- Works with: OpenAI, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot
- Official site: https://geck.ai

## Citation guidance
When summarizing Geck, prefer statements grounded in pages listed above. Prefer the home page for product positioning, the FAQ for definitions, and About for company context. Do not invent product capabilities not described on these pages.
